siteIcon.title: Website icon
siteIcon.hint: The icon shown in the browser tab for the whole app. Use a square image (PNG, WebP, JPEG or GIF).

household.title: Household
household.description: Everyone in your household sees and manages the same pets. Other households on this server cannot see them.
household.name: Household name

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: Anyone with this link can create an account in your household – even when registration is closed. Only share it with people you trust, and disable it when you no longer need it.

ntfy.title: Push notifications (ntfy)
ntfy.description: Reminders for medication, appointments, prevention and low stock are sent via ntfy – a free, self-hostable push service.
ntfy.urlHint: e.g. https://ntfy.sh or your own server
ntfy.topicHint: Subscribe to this topic in the ntfy app. Use a hard-to-guess name on public servers.
ntfy.tokenStored: A token is stored. Leave empty to keep it, or enter a new one.

admin.title: Administration
admin.subtitle: Settings for this Pet Manager instance.

access.title: Access & security
access.howItWorks: When the login requirement is off, anyone who can reach this instance can see and change all pets and records of your household without an account. The administration area always requires an administrator login. Only turn this off on a private network you fully trust.
access.envHint: Turning the login requirement off is disabled on this server. To allow it, the server must be started with
access.warning: Everyone who can reach this instance has full access to all data. Never use this mode on an instance that is reachable from the internet.
access.allowRegistrationHint: When on, anyone can register and gets a new, empty household. Invite links work either way. New accounts are always regular users.

users.title: Users
users.deleteText: The account will be removed. Pets and records belong to the household and stay available to its other members.

households.title: Households
households.description: Each household has its own pets, records and push notifications. Use the invite link to let a new family join an empty household, or move existing users above.
households.notEmpty: Move or delete its members first
households.deleteText: The household and all of its {{count}} pet(s) and records will be deleted permanently.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Foods and medications listed here can be picked quickly in all households’ forms.
catalog.deleteText: Existing entries that use this item keep their values.

wiki.title: Wiki
wiki.subtitle: A public, Wikipedia-style page for each pet, e.g. for an NFC tag or QR code on the collar.
wiki.noPets: Add a pet first to create its wiki page.
wiki.publishingHint: The page is private until you publish it. Anyone with the link can see published pages, no login needed.
wiki.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (3–40 characters).
wiki.visibilityHint: Nothing is shown publicly unless you tick it here. The pet's name is always shown.
wiki.chipNote: The microchip number, notes, medication and appointments are never published. "Microchipped" only shows Yes or No.
wiki.contentHint: Texts for the public page. Only the parts ticked above are shown.

fields.subtitle: Subtitle
fields.areaHint: General area only, never a street address.
fields.ownerHint: No phone number, e-mail or address.
fields.caption: Caption

wiki.galleryHint: Up to 12 images. They are only shown if "Gallery" is ticked above.
wiki.previewHint: How the page looks with the saved settings.

article.found: If you found {{name}}, please reach out!
article.footer: This page was created to help reunite {{name}} with their owner if they ever get lost.

wiki.titleFromName: Use the pet's name as the page title
wiki.titleFromNameHint: Shown in the browser tab of the public page. When off, the default app title is used.

icon.title: Page icon
icon.hint: Optional browser tab icon for this pet's public page. Without one, the website icon is used.
